answer: We define a mechanism where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds enforce capital barriers, requiring validators to lock assets in a shale of cryptoeconomic primitives that mirror legitimate stake distributions. Subgame-perfect punishment matrices apply slashing penalties exceeding the potential nectar of illicit rewards, ensuring the expected utility of identity multiplication remains strictly negative for any agent.
